about.heading: Bridging business analytics, web development, and digital products.
about.intro: I am a Business Analytics & AI student at EMAA Business School in Agadir, Morocco, focused on building practical web applications and digital tools.
about.intersectionText: My approach combines business understanding with software development. Rather than relying solely on theoretical coursework, I learn by engineering complete digital products that solve real operational challenges.
about.proofText: My technical foundation is proven through deployed applications like BusinessOS—a 15-model operational platform with role-based permissions and real-time analytics—along with responsive storefronts and web tools.
about.experienceText: During my internship at Wilaya de la Région Souss-Massa (Préfecture d'Agadir Ida Outanane), I observed public administrative workflows firsthand, strengthening my understanding of organizational data and system requirements.
about.directionText: I am working toward a career combining Data Analytics, AI, and Software Engineering. I am currently seeking internship opportunities, junior roles, and freelance collaborations where I can contribute practical product development skills.
